title: Reasoning trace for a posted journal entry
description: Recorded with every post_entry call. What the agent looked at, the rule it applied, how sure it is, and why, in its own words. Auditors ask for this; the harness requires it.

evidence.description: What was considered: bank line ids, invoice or bill numbers, payout report ids, prior entry ids.

rule.description: The rule or judgement applied, in a few words.

reason.description: Why this entry, in one to three sentences.
